tier1.text: Lysosomes act as the cell's garbage disposal, breaking down worn-out cell parts. Lysosomes do this with digestive enzymes, which are proteins that speed up chemical reactions. White blood cells that engulf bacteria are packed with lysosomes, which digest the bacteria. New lysosomes form from sacs of enzymes sent out by the Golgi apparatus, which packages proteins.

sentences.text: Lysosomes act as the cell's garbage disposal, breaking down worn-out cell parts.

quotes.quote: The lysosomes are the cell’s “garbage disposal.” In plant cells, the digestive processes take place in vacuoles. Enzymes within the lysosomes aid in breaking down proteins, polysaccharides, lipids, nucleic acids, and even worn-out organelles.
quotes.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Lysosomes do this with digestive enzymes, which are proteins that speed up chemical reactions.

quotes.quote: A lysosome is an organelle that contains enzymes that break down and digest unneeded cellular components, such as a damaged organelle.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: An enzyme is a catalytic protein that speeds up chemical reactions in the human body.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: White blood cells that engulf bacteria are packed with lysosomes, which digest the bacteria.

quotes.quote: For example, when certain immune defense cells (white blood cells) phagocytize bacteria, the bacterial cell is transported into a lysosome and digested by the enzymes inside. As one might imagine, such phagocytic defense cells contain large numbers of lysosomes.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: New lysosomes form from sacs of enzymes sent out by the Golgi apparatus, which packages proteins.

quotes.quote: The enzyme-containing vesicles released by the Golgi may form new lysosomes, or fuse with existing, lysosomes.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: Golgi apparatus: cellular organelle formed by a series of flattened, membrane-bound sacs that functions in protein modification, tagging, packaging, and transport
